title: Number Theory from First Principles
summary: A self-contained proof-driven introduction to integer arithmetic: Euclid and primes, congruences and reconstruction, finite multiplicative arithmetic, Diophantine equations, continued fractions, Pell equations and the first ideas of quadratic reciprocity. Connects elementary proofs to abstract algebra, algorithms and arithmetic geometry.
assumed_background: integer arithmetic, fractions, equations and basic algebra
comfortable reading simple proofs helps; the Mathematical Reasoning and Proof course is optional preparation
no group theory, field theory or analytic number theory assumed

lectures.title: Divisibility, Euclid's Algorithm, and the Architecture of Prime Factorization
Congruences, Inverses, and the Chinese Remainder Theorem
Units, Euler's Theorem, and Multiplicative Order
Integer Equations, Rational Points, and Pythagorean Triples
Continued Fractions, Rational Approximation, and Pell Equations
Quadratic Residues and the Reciprocity Puzzle
